text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Guess everybody really loves
these G1
races—just listen to that
crowd!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No way! I can't wait to get goin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Winning in these big races is what's
gonna bring
me closer to becoming
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the G1 level's where all the
strongest
Umamusume are at! It's bound
to be heaps of fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited, I'm fit to curse!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, that! But ya gotta admit, my
way's got a
certain ring to it! Hehe.
choice_data_list: If anything, I'd say I'm trembling with excitement.
